name: Caprese Prime Rib Beef Burger with Tomato, Fresh Mozzarella, Basil Pesto & Sweet Potato Fries

ingredients.name: julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil (optional).
When the oven is heated, transfer fries to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake until starting to turn golden, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (20 oz) bag julienne cut sweet potato fries, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheet from the oven and flip fries. Return to the oven and continue to bake until fries are golden and crispy, 10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add beef patties and grill, undisturbed, for 3-3½ minutes; flip patties and grill an additional 3-3½ minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a plate.

While the patties are cooking, split buns in half and place on another baking sheet, arranging them cut-side up. Add to the oven and bake until buns are lightly toasted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry tomatoes. Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into thin rounds, then season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place bottom half of each bun on a plate; layer with pesto, a burger patty, tomato and mozzarella. Close with the top half of each bun and serve with sweet potato fries. Enjoy!
